title: metadata-protocol: a name held only by stored rows of two enabled packages answers the bare read by save order while /layers refuses 409 (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi

Filing category: ① product defect with a named location (out-of-scope finding of #32354's step 0, measured on `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` @ `6655b742`; note `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/card-32354/step0.md`). #32354 covers the case where one holder is disabled; this card is the same order guess with no disabled package.
Part of #31527 (ADR-0150) · Refs #32354

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：两个启用包各存了一行同名项、没有包在代码里自带它时，不带包名的读取要像 /layers 一样答 409 并点名两个包，而不是按保存顺序给第一行。
- 为什么：现在同一个名字，裸读答"先保存的那一行"，/layers 却答 409；答案靠保存顺序猜，违反专题红线"歧义要报告、不许猜"。
- 风险：第一方 0 处；裸读 200 → 409（收窄，需声明并钉住）。
- 先看：`packagelessAddress` 的候选 → `packagelessContentPackage`（无代码持有者时为 undefined）→ `findServedOverlayRow` 取第一行。
- 验证：E、F 都启用，各存一行 d1，两种保存顺序下裸读都应 409 点名 E、F。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## What happens

`packagelessAddress` candidates are both row bindings; with no package shipping the name, `packagelessContentPackage` answers `undefined`, and `findServedOverlayRow` takes the first row by save order. `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` counts both bindings and answers 409. So the bare read and `/layers` disagree, and the bare read is a guess by order.

## Do

The bare read of a name with two or more served row holders and no shipper answers the same 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT with `details.candidates` naming each served holder that `/layers` gives. Pin both save orders, both transports; CONTROL: one row holder answers unchanged. FROM → TO: bare read 200 (first-saved row) → 409 naming both (narrowing, Clause-② yes).

Reuse #32354's row-aware served-holder judgment (it lands the served set over registry holders ∪ stored-row bindings).
Blocked-by: #32354
Reader who acts: the server seat the epic seat routes it to. Epic red-line read before landing.
Grade: p2 (first-party reach 0).
